name: Restorative & Endodontic Dentistry — Tooth Repair, Fillings, and Root Canal Care
description: Comprehensive, evidence-aligned restorative dentistry including caries management, minimally invasive fillings, pulp therapy, root canal treatment (endodontics), post-core, crown, bridgework, and biomaterial choices. Integrates pain management, microscope-assisted care, and adhesive innovations for long-term preservation.
keywords: restorative dentistry, tooth filling, composite resin, glass ionomer, amalgam alternatives, inlay onlay, dental crown, post core, root canal treatment, endodontic therapy, microscope dentistry, adhesive dentistry, caries excavation, pulp protection, biomaterials

hasPart.name: Tooth Decay (Caries)
hasPart.description: Destruction of tooth enamel and dentin by acid-producing bacteria; common cause of pain and tooth loss if untreated.

possibleTreatment.name: Tooth filling with composite resin or glass-ionomer
Root canal therapy for deep decay

hasPart.name: Tooth-Colored Filling (Composite / Glass Ionomer)
hasPart.description: Restores form and function of carious tooth using adhesive resin or glass ionomer. Minimally invasive, esthetic, mercury-free.
hasPart.followup: Routine polishing and bite adjustment within 7 days.

hasPart.name: Indirect Restorations (Inlays, Onlays, Crowns)
hasPart.description: Laboratory-fabricated restorations for large cavities or structurally compromised teeth. Improve strength and esthetics.
hasPart.possibleComplication: Marginal leakage or fracture if poorly bonded.

hasPart.name: Pulpitis
hasPart.description: Reversible or irreversible inflammation of dental pulp due to decay or trauma; causes sharp, lingering pain.

possibleTreatment.name: Pulp capping or partial pulpotomy (reversible cases)

hasPart.name: Root Canal Treatment (Endodontic Therapy)
hasPart.description: Removal of infected pulp, cleaning, shaping, and obturation of canals to preserve natural tooth. Performed under local anesthesia, often microscope-assisted.

guideline.guidelineSubject: Root canal therapy indications and steps

possibleTreatment.name: Antibiotics for systemic infection (as per guidelines)
Post-core and crown restoration after RCT

study.name: Outcome of root canal treatment
study.studyDesign: Systematic reviews — >90% survival with adequate restoration

hasPart.name: Post & Core + Crown Restoration
hasPart.description: Reinforcement of endodontically treated tooth using fiber post and composite core buildup, followed by full-coverage crown.

hasPart.name: Cracked Tooth Syndrome
hasPart.description: Incomplete tooth fracture leading to pain on biting and temperature changes.

hasPart.name: Discolored Non-vital Tooth
hasPart.description: Darkening following trauma or RCT; esthetic concern.

subjectOf.name: Minimally Invasive Dentistry Protocol
subjectOf.description: Preserve sound tooth structure, control caries, use adhesive restorations and magnification.

subjectOf.name: Pain Management in Endodontics
subjectOf.description: Local anesthesia, occlusal adjustment, short-term analgesics as per guideline.

citation.name: Sturdevant’s Art and Science of Operative Dentistry

audience.audienceType: Patients seeking restorative or root canal care
